author: mgv723
quote: Sorry, but I don't understand what they have done with this game. Bring back Dan Houser! The critics reviews are clearly in the can, best game of all time? The notion is absurd and such universal acclaim is obviously coordinated. I've been playing this for almost 40 hours now and it just isn't GTA anymore. Would refund if I could but of course they took away physical copies.

author: mgv723
quote: Absolutely phenomenal game, encapsulates the spirit and magic of what gaming ought to be about. You can feel the love and dedication to the craft oozing from every corner, secret, dungeon, and the artistry is off the charts. Nintendo needs to up its game a bit on the voice acting but otherwise this is perfect.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
